name: @bubstack/moe-crew
description: Launch, control and monitor Claude Code, Codex, and Pi workers over tmux.

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/clean-package-dist.mjs && cd ../.. && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/write-bundle-inventory.mjs --prepare packages/crew && tsc -b packages/crew/tsconfig.json --force && packages/crew/node_modules/.bin/tsup --config packages/crew/tsup.config.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/write-bundle-inventory.mjs packages/crew packages/crew/dist/metafile-cjs.json packages/crew/dist/metafile-esm.json
